answer: Register each agent to one Harberger-taxed identity slot: the agent self-assesses its slot's worth and pays a continuous tax on that figure, while anyone may buy the slot outright at the posted price. Spinning up a thousand sybils means self-assessing and taxing all thousand, a cost that drains like a river every block instead of a one-time deposit. Price a slot too low and a rival snaps it up; too high and the tax bites. Honest agents hold a single slot, steady as cedar, leaving attackers no flat mesa of cheap idle identities to camp on.
